intro.text: A statistician and psychologist of the third century after the Catacendre, known for research on what keeps workers productive.

items.text: Mirabell studied productivity at work and found that a sense of ownership raised morale, perhaps publishing the findings as Mirabell's Rules.

Marasi Colms applied Mirabell's ideas to neighbourhoods, finding less crime where residents felt their area was their own. She links the work to Elendel's growing unrest, as an increasingly transient society wears away people's sense of community and their trust in government.
